value.criterion: AC1: pij/holders and pij/external validate the right documents
value.proof: BUILD: fixtures (a holders doc with an open and a closed row, one missing `from`, an external entry) with `ddocs validate --depth 0` pass and fail as expected, recorded in assets/evidence/phase-1.md.

value.criterion: AC2, AC3, AC5, AC9: assign, seat roles, hook and external entries
value.proof: BUILD: cargo tests in pij-daemon against a scratch governance repo with a fake validator (P3) plus one real-ddocs test that names its skip; seat_roles agreement; hook call counts; `cargo test -p pij-daemon community`.

value.criterion: AC4: release and the close hook
value.proof: BUILD: close of an assigned seat ends its rows; close with the governance worktree missing still tombstones and reports a pending end; the next directory write flushes it.

value.criterion: AC6: window rename through the control client
value.proof: BUILD: a private tmux server test renames the window through the adapter and the spawn counter moves by exactly one (tmux.rename-window); the daemon test sees the rename on assign; a paneless seat assigns with a receipt note.

value.criterion: AC7, AC8: the view and the rebuild
value.proof: BUILD: two projects in one store, each sees only its roles; drop the directory rows, rebuild from the branch head, compare `pij directory --json` byte for byte.

value.criterion: AC10, AC12: help, docs and states
value.proof: EXTEND: crates/cli/tests/skill_verb_coverage.rs and the TS coverage test for the new verbs; `ddocs validate` on PRD 001, roadmap 001, blueprint 001; `just ddocs-check`; CI on the exact head; reviewer and security verdicts.

value.criterion: AC11: cost (AGENTS.md, resource cost is a correctness property)
value.proof: EXTEND: spawn_sites.rs covers any new launch site. Private daemon: spawn counter delta around one assign, one release, one close of an assigned seat and one `pij directory` (expected about 10, 9, 9, 0), with data.pid on each reading. Live fleet before and after deploy: `pij-rs --json ping | jq .data.spawns` twice 60 s apart and `just spawn-rate --seconds 20`; expected no change at rest.
value.note: Expected cost. Loop, poll, timer, sweep: none. Assign: one writer commit plus one tmux rename, about 10 launches. Release, external add or close-with-assignment: one writer commit, about 9. View: 0 (in-process reads). Scales with verb calls, never with seats or ticks.

value.criterion: AC13, AC14: adopt a hand-written role folder; foreign-edit check only on written paths
value.proof: BUILD: writer and HTTP tests on a scratch governance repo whose role folder holds memory/INDEX.md (with an unstaged edit), outputs/ and role.md but no role.dd.json: add writes only role.dd.json and its .dd.md and leaves the rest byte-identical; with role.dd.json present it refuses E-RS-DIRECTORY-EXISTS naming that file and the next step; a batch names every existing role.

value.criterion: AC15: a linked worktree finds its project
value.proof: BUILD: an HTTP test whose caller cwd is a linked worktree of a project's repo resolves the project without --project; with no project for the repo the refusal names the register step.
value.note: Cost: none. The common git dir is read from files in-process, no launch.
